//: Tested revisions. install uses exactly these; status reports drift. Nothing here is auto-promoted from upstream - a new upstream commit is only pinned after it has been installed and exercised locally.

node_packs.name: hades-anima-suite
node_packs.notes: Supersedes the previous pin (fb2b26f), which was not a HaDeS commit at all: the build machine's pack folder carried ComfyUI's .git metadata, so the recorded SHA belonged to Comfy-Org/ComfyUI and could never resolve here. Lock entries are now checked against their declared origin.
node_packs.verified: 2026-11-06: cloned from upstream at this SHA, 25 node classes register, HaDeSAnimaMultiModelMerger and HaDeSAnimaModelSaver present, live render passes.

node_packs.name: RES4LYF
node_packs.notes: Adds 2 schedulers (9 -> 11) and 19 samplers (45 -> 64) to KSampler; SwarmUI merges those lists at backend connect. 1.2.2 is required on ComfyUI 0.45+: 1.2.1 called comfy.model_management.is_directml_enabled, which ComfyUI removed, so every KSampler (SwarmKSampler included) died with AttributeError at sample time.
node_packs.verified: 2026-11-14: checked out at this SHA on ComfyUI 0.45.0; RES4LYF imports clean (no removed-API call sites, see TESTS/test_nodepack_compat.py); SwarmKSampler + beta57 rendered a real 512x512 image with woomixAnima_v180.

python_packages.name: comfyui-mcp
python_packages.notes: Pinned npm package. Reads COMFYUI_URL / --comfyui-url; ignores COMFYUI_HOST and COMFYUI_PORT.
